data.title: 雷姆 · 雨夜告白
data.description: 【雷姆 · 雨夜告白】暴雨倾盆的王都钟楼下，被泪水与雨水浸湿的雷姆紧紧握着昴的手，哪怕面对全世界的放弃与绝望，她依然绽放出世间最美丽的笑容——「就算所有人都放弃了昴君，雷姆也绝对不会放弃！从这里开始吧……从一……不，从零开始！」
data.action: 在钟楼下回望，雨声如诉
data.promptProse: Rem looks back beneath the rain-swept clock tower, tearful blue eyes and an earnest expression carrying her emotional confession toward the viewer. Her soft casual off-duty outfit remains around the shoulders in the close-up, tower masonry visible behind her. Warm streetlight catches the tears and near hair strands, while colder rainy daylight from the open street outlines the opposite cheek; droplets cross the darker stone recesses beyond her face.
